subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should OpenClaw accept these 14 external GitHub Action upgrades after reviewing the privileged-action and Codex-action source changes on the final rebased head?
rationale: The patch intentionally changes executable third-party code in credential-bearing and release/security workflows; source-level security acceptance is a maintainer responsibility, not a mechanical repair decision.

options.title: Review and merge after final-head proof
options.body: Verify the upgraded action revisions and approve once the final rebased workflow run succeeds.

options.title: Hold selected privileged upgrades
options.body: Split out or defer the token, release, and Codex action updates if their upstream changes do not meet the repository’s security bar.

recommendation.title: Review and merge after final-head proof
recommendation.body: Verify the upgraded action revisions and approve once the final rebased workflow run succeeds.
